svg.text: Three brokers: durable disk confirmation at fixed load
Linux VM on a 2018 Mac Mini, Intel Core i7-8700B @ 3.20GHz, 6 cores, performance governor, turbo off
Writer confirmation: full color; verified reader: lighter shade; 1M/s Ozzy only
Ozzy: per record; adaptive LZ4 APPENDs up to 2048 records; <= 2048 KiB payload; 3 in flight
Iggy: explicit batches up to 1024 records
Redpanda: per record; SDK batches up to 1024 records or 4 MiB
